title.en: R 1 2022 ED SYARIAH COURTS COURT FEES AND COSTS RULES

text.en: These Rules may be cited as Syariah Courts (Court Fees and Costs) Rules.
These Rules apply to any proceedings begun in a Syariah Court on or after the date of commencement of these Rules. Court fees and costs
The court fees and costs set out in the Schedule shall be payable in all proceedings in a Syariah Court. (rule 3)
Issue of judgment madin summons $40
Appeal to the Syariah High Court $100
Appeal to the Syariah Court of Appeal $200
Obtaining judgment or Order $10
Application for execution of judgment $10
Warrant of arrest in lieu of or in addition to summons $40
Order of execution against judgment madin $40
Order of committal to prison $40
Commission on sums realised by attachment in execution of $1,000 2.5% thereafter
If the claim is settled or compromised after issue of order of

Serving summon, warrant or subpoena —

(a) within 8 kilometres of Court house $20

(b) more than 8 kilometres from Court house $40
Subsistence for imprisoned judgment madin per day $40
Request for subpoena $10

(a) Attestation of signature, certificate or fact of $8 registration by Syariah Subordinate Court Judge or a Registrar of Syariah Court

(b) On taking an affidavit, declaration or $8 acknowledgement, whether done before a Syariah Court Judge or a Registrar of Syariah Court

(c) For each exhibit or document referred to in a $4 document specified in paragraph (b)
Search or inspection, for each hour $20
Copy of record per page $2
Copy of any other document per page $2
Translation of any document or verification of translation by $20 any Court Interpreter or Translator, per page

Allowances to witnesses —

(a) Expert witness. Reasonable travelling expenses and $80 for attendance for each hour or part thereof, up to —

(b) Other witness. Reasonable travelling expenses and $20 for attendance for each hour or part thereof, up to —
Application for substituted service $20
Taxation of bill of costs $20.
